title: HR-AFGW-SWTGW018ANS-100
brief: HRUI 9-Port 10 Gigabit Uplink 2.5G Web Managed PoE Switch is designed to provide 2.5Gbps RJ-45 ports and 10Gbps SFP+ ports to create lightning-fast and reliable connections. With this switch, you can effortlessly bridge the gap between WiFi 6 access points, storage servers, and other devices to receive both data and power over a single Ethernet cable simultaneously.
parameter:
Highlight

• 8 *100/1000/2500Mbps PoE ports+1 *10G SFP+ port
• Complies with  IEEE 802.3, IEEE 802.3u, IEEE 802.3ab, IEEE 802.3bz, IEEE 802.3ae, IEEE 802.3x standards
• PoE port supports 100/1000/2500Mbps adaptive
• Supports PoE priority, default enabled in order from 1 to 8 ports
• Supports automatic port flipping (Auto MDI/MDIX)
• The panel indicator lights will monitor the working status and assist in fault analysis
• Flow control method, IEEE802.3x standard for full-duplex and Backpressure standard for half duplex
